_doc: Operator data for the equity bucket (fundarb.events, fundarb.equity). Not in Hyperliquid's API. calendar: earnings / holidays / halts / rebalances / splits / news; until covers_until is set and in the future every new equity entry is blocked. index_baskets: published constituent weights per index market, e.g. {"xyz:INDEX": {"weights": {"xyz:NAME": 0.08}, "source": "...", "as_of": "YYYY-MM-DD"}}; without one the basket is chosen statistically and labelled so.
